note: City campground on one dead-end road within 78-acre Waukon City Park, with a playground, two shelters and trails to the aquatic center and Indian Springs Pond at the park's south edge (not beside the sites). Sites run from tent to large RV. --Claude
summary: $35 confirmed; water/electric hookups confirmed but the 50-amp claim cleared (city states no amperage); site count 30 and wifi cleared (unsourced); showers/dump confirmed; phone reservations optional. Season not stated anywhere official.
flags: FIT: the city says 'sites ranging from tent camping to large RV's'; no length posted. On imagery the campground is two long gravel loops plus an open lawn edge with several travel trailers and a motorhome parked; a 23-ft rig fits.
SEASON: not stated on any city page (only 'The park is open daily 6am - 10pm'); none written. Aggregators give no dates either.

CLEARED: electric 50 (no amperage on the city page; aggregators conflict - Campendium '20 Amp', Outdoorsy '30 or 50 amp'), sites.count 30 (aggregators say 16 or 42) and wifi (not mentioned by the city). All rested on old note prose.
